_comment: digperiphs (TRNG) proof configuration: the Castalia defaults with the TRNG0 ring-oscillator entropy source + harvest engine instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 9 (peripherals.trng=true, @0x6900). TRNG0 adds NO new pins -- the ring-oscillator ensemble is internal combinational fabric behind a SIM/REAL architecture split (TrngRoEnsemble_sim.vhd behavioral-only, TrngRoEnsemble.vhd genus/gate-only), never a pad. The whole harvest engine (RO 2-FF sync, decimator, 32-bit direct-pack assembler, read-CONSUMES data register with the D9 DRDY same-cycle blind-window fix, repetition-count health test with auto-halt, IRQ combiner) rides the free-running MCLK (D4-clean: plain raw-strobe active-low shim, no CAPTURE_CLOCK pre-latch), so the SYS_CLK_CR=0 footgun does NOT bind TRNG0. Enabling it extends the IRQ source list per the A5 GLOBAL VECTOR RULE from 121 (the NPU-only default: vector 120 = NPU0_TD, 121 = IRQB_RSVD121) to 122: 114-119 backfill as IRQB_RSVD (RTC/PWM/OW/DMA off), 120 = NPU0_TD (npu defaults true), 121 = TRNG0 (combined data-ready/health-alarm). MmrAddrTRNG0 + RegSlotTRNG0* appear in MemoryMap.vhd only when the knob is on. Everything else is default (trngRings stays at its default of 8). Prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_trng.json
